packageRules.description: The kernel, pnpm, slicc-cdp, slicc-jsh and the wasm, wasi and wasix command packages (the base set's and the optional catalog's) go to seven only after the homescoop coordinator certifies them, often as a set. slicc-agent and slicc-spectrum are held too: agent releases can carry a newer kernel client, both change the UI and follow the spectrum ordering rule, and their automerges kept conflicting with bios PRs that change the neighbouring pins. bios takes all of these by hand, with their certs.json lines, so Renovate lists them on the dependency dashboard and opens a PR only when one is ticked there, instead of a PR per release that runs the whole suite.
